articles.title: If the Red Sox can get past the Yankees, the Chad Tracy story goes from a good one to a great one
articles.description: Tracy was called away from managing a game with Triple-A Worcester on April 25 and told he would manage the Red Sox the next day. Five months later, he's preparing for the postseason.

articles.description: The Red Sox fell in the AL Wild Card Series to the Yankees last year, but will hope for better results this time around.

articles.title: Garrett Crochet deems himself ready to return to Red Sox: ‘It’s just a matter of if anybody agrees with me’
articles.description: Jumping from pitching against fellow Red Sox to pitching in the playoffs in the Bronx would be a massive step.

articles.title: Former Red Sox announcers Ken Coleman and Ned Martin among finalists for Hall of Fame’s Ford C. Frick Award
articles.description: The ballot this year is for announcers whose careers concluded before 1994.

articles.title: Payton Tolle will be a main character in this Red Sox-Yankees series. And what a character he is.
